title: notes-tasks@1
description: One store per project on axHub (hub-table@1 tables `items` and `lists`, hub-settings@1 document key `looks`). Notes, to-dos, tasks and lists are ONE item type: every node is an `item`; what it shows (body, checkbox, status, priority, due) is its `look`, a preset that can change at any time without losing data. Any item can hold any other through `parent`, nested to any depth. Every amberx-notes@1 row stays readable: `kind` is read as the look, a `lists` row is read as an item that holds the items whose `list` names it. Design: apps/console-web/plugins/notes-tasks/DESIGN.md.

project.description: projects@1 id the store belongs to (amberx-axf = the base project, folder amberx-notes/).

lists.description: amberx-notes@1 `lists` rows. Read as items (see legacyList); the console writes new containers to `items` and only updates rows that already exist here, so the phone stays in step until it moves to the engine.

iso.description: ISO 8601 date-time; '' where a field allows none.

lookId.description: A key of `looks`: the built-ins `note`, `todo`, `task`, `list`, or one Brett added. Unknown → `note`.

item.description: The one item type. Every field is valid on every item whatever its look; the look only decides what is shown and asked for.

parent.description: The item (or legacy list) that holds this one; '' = the project's root. Any item may hold any other, to any depth; the engine refuses a move that would make an item its own ancestor.

childLook.description: The look a new child gets: a to-do list is an item with childLook `todo`, a task list one with `task`. Absent = `note`.

collapsed.description: Children folded in the tree (view state, shared by every client).

text.description: Body (Markdown). Children render after it, in order.

aliases.description: Spoken names, so voice can find any item (a list or not) to add to.

system.description: System items: renamed, never removed or moved off the root.

status.description: Any item may carry one. Shown when the look has a checkbox; '' is not allowed, absent = open.

due.description: YYYY-MM-DD, an ISO date-time, or '' for none

checklist.description: Legacy (amberx-notes@1). Read as checkable children; the console's first write to the item turns the entries into child items with look `todo` and empties this.

fields.description: Custom fields by key. A field belongs to the item, not its look: changing the look hides fields the new look does not show and never deletes them.

kind.description: Legacy mirror for amberx-notes@1 readers. Read as `look` when `look` is absent; the engine writes it from the look (note for anything that is not todo or task) and never reads it when `look` is set.

list.description: Legacy mirror for amberx-notes@1 readers: the nearest ancestor that is a `lists` row (else `inbox`). Read as `parent` when `parent` is ''.

legacyList.description: amberx-notes@1 list row. The engine reads it as an item: name → title, the rest as named, look `list`, childLook from its rows' kinds.

look.description: A preset over the one item type: what an item with this look shows and asks for. Never a type: no field is only valid under some look.

checkbox.description: The item shows a tick box (counts towards its holder's done / total).

statuses.description: The statuses the UI offers for this look (a subset of the four). A stored status outside it is kept and shown as is.

childLook.description: Default childLook for a new item of this look.

looks.description: Looks by id (hub-settings@1 document settings/notes-tasks[-<project>].json, key `looks`). The four built-ins are always present (they can be edited, not removed); Brett may add up to 12 more.
